content.text: Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `solution.py`. It tracks the last accepted timestamp per exact key, rejects later occurrences only when `t - last_accepted < ttl`, keeps rejected duplicates from refreshing the timestamp, and accepts when the gap is `>= ttl` (so `ttl == 0` accepts everything). It returns `{"accepted": [...], "rejected": [...]}` as zero-based payload indices in original order without mutating inputs.
